Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFSignatureValidationReport

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFSignatureValidationReport
public class CPDFSignatureValidationReport extends Object
Validation report for a single signature field, produced by CPDFSignatureValidator.

getOverallStatus() aggregates all executed checks; the individual items tell which check produced which result. Instances are created from native code and are read-only.

    • isLtvEnabled

      public boolean isLtvEnabled()
      Checks whether this report contains a VALID pades.baseline_lt.valid item.

      This depends on the validation options used. Revocation checking must be enabled to obtain an LT verdict. A false value can mean missing evidence, failed validation or skipped checks; inspect getItems() to distinguish them. The flag is per signature and does not replace getOverallStatus().

      For document-level material presence rather than a validated profile, use CPDFLtvService.assessReadiness(com.compdfkit.core.document.CPDFDocument).

      Returns:
      true if the core's LT profile item is present and VALID

    • hasEmbeddedTimestamp

      public boolean hasEmbeddedTimestamp()
      Checks whether the embedded RFC 3161 timestamp passed imprint, signature and trust-chain validation.

      Despite the method name, mere presence is insufficient. Disabled checks or missing trust anchors may produce false even when a token is embedded. Use CPDFSignature.getTimestampSource() to inspect presence/source only.

      Returns:
      true when all three embedded-timestamp checks have VALID items
